concerns.text: FR-013 (Slack 1979 temperature normalization) is unimplemented. Task T015 is marked with an empty checkbox [ ] and described as 'Implement src/cleaning/temperature_normalize.py', but the task list indicates it is incomplete/rejected in the context of the analyze report. Without a completed task for T015, the mandatory normalization step before correlation/regression is missing.

FR-010 (Provenance verification) is partially unimplemented. Task T014 ('Implement src/cleaning/provenance_validator.py') is marked with an empty checkbox [ ]. While T013 handles merging and null removal, it does not explicitly verify that every entry has a non-empty `source_reference` and that the source is peer-reviewed/NIST as required by FR-010. The missing T014 leaves the provenance verification gap.

FR-003 (Structural descriptor calculation) is unimplemented. Task T018 ('Implement src/descriptors/compute_descriptors.py') is marked with an empty checkbox [ ]. This blocks User Story 2 entirely, preventing the calculation of octahedral tilting angles, bond-length variance, and tolerance factors required for the correlation analysis.

FR-014 (Stratification by chemistry class) is unimplemented. Task T019 ('Implement src/analysis/stratify.py') is marked with an empty checkbox [ ]. The spec requires stratification before correlation analysis; without this task, the analysis cannot be performed per the required methodology.

FR-004 (Correlation analysis with multiple-comparison correction) is unimplemented. Task T020 ('Implement src/analysis/correlation.py') is marked with an empty checkbox [ ]. This is the core analysis task for US2.

FR-008 (VIF calculation) is unimplemented. Task T021 ('Extend src/utils/validation.py... with VIF > 5 exclusion logic') is marked with an empty checkbox [ ]. This is required for US2 to address collinearity.

FR-009 (Sensitivity analysis) is unimplemented. Task T022 ('Implement src/analysis/sensitivity.py') is marked with an empty checkbox [ ]. While T024 is a test for this, the implementation task T022 is missing.
FR-005 (Regression with 5-fold CV) is unimplemented. Task T027 ('Implement src/analysis/regression.py...') is marked with an empty checkbox [ ]. This blocks User Story 3.

FR-007 (Causal-language check) is unimplemented. Task T028 ('Extend src/utils/validation.py... with scan_causal_language') is marked with an empty checkbox [ ]. This is a mandatory pipeline fail condition.
FR-012 (Scatter plots with 95% CI) is unimplemented. Task T029 ('Implement src/analysis/visualize.py') is marked with an empty checkbox [ ].
FR-011 (Feature importance report) is unimplemented. Task T031 ('Generate feature importance report...') is marked with an empty checkbox [ ].
FR-015 (R² > 0.5 justification) is unimplemented. Task T030 ('Generate R² > 0.5 performance target justification...') is marked with an empty checkbox [ ].
FR-006 (Model evaluation) is unimplemented. Task T027 covers this, but since T027 is incomplete, the evaluation of R², RMSE, and feature importance is missing.

Constitution VII conflict resolution is unimplemented. Task T037 ('Document Constitution VII vs FR-010 conflict...') is marked with an empty checkbox [ ]. While documentation is a task, the plan indicates a conflict that needs resolution or explicit amendment path; leaving this task incomplete leaves the project in a state of non-compliance with the Constitution.

Constitution V (Artifact hashing) is unimplemented. Task T040 ('Generate content hashes for ALL artifacts...') is marked with an empty checkbox [ ]. This is required for reproducibility and versioning.
Constitution II (Reference validation) is unimplemented. Task T039 ('Execute Reference-Validator Agent on final_report.md...') is marked with an empty checkbox [ ].
